svg.title: The 64 hexagrams as line diagrams, in King Wen order
svg.desc: Eight rows of eight. Each hexagram is six horizontal lines read bottom to top: a solid line is yang, a line broken in the middle is yin. Every hexagram carries its own text alternative giving its King Wen number and its six lines in bottom-to-top order.

g.aria-label: Hexagram 1, ䷀; lines bottom to top: yang, yang, yang, yang, yang, yang
g.title: Hexagram 1 ䷀ — yang, yang, yang, yang, yang, yang (bottom to top)
